items.quote: Use the Marketing API to automate advertising across Meta technologies. The API provides functions for ad creation, management, and performance analysis.
items.why: Quote states API automates ad creation, management, and performance analysis; platform list not stated.

items.quote: If you're managing someone's ads, use the `scope` parameter to prompt them for the `ads_management` or `ads_read` permissions. Your app gets access when they click **Allow**.
items.why: Quote covers ads_management/ads_read scope consent only; not the full list of auth methods.

items.quote: You can also use a [system user access token](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/business-management-apis/system-users) to access the ads MCP server
items.why: Mentions system user token for MCP server; does not establish public API auth methods.

items.quote: Your tier is determined by whether your app has been approved through App Review.
items.why: Tier depends on App Review approval; consistent with approval gate but not the full gate.

items.quote: Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only. Not for production apps running for live advertisers.
items.why: States limited access is dev-only and rate-limited; does not state approval gate for credentials.

items.quote: Access detailed insights and analytics to track ad performance and make data-driven decisions to improve outcomes
items.why: Covers insights/analytics only; says nothing about REST, versioning, or breadth of endpoints.

items.quote: The server is remote-hosted at `https://mcp.facebook.com/ads` and works with any MCP-compatible AI agent.
items.why: States remote MCP server exists at the claimed URL; vendor-official not explicitly stated.

items.quote: Business verification is a process that allows us to verify your identity as a business entity, which we require if your app will access sensitive data.
items.why: Defines Business Verification only; no verdict, App Review, or Limited-access blocker mentioned.
